notes: Metadata refers to original unmodified supplied PNGs.
Source sheets are not uniform grids. Some action sword/effect contours overlap adjacent cells; inspect selected regions and remove foreign residue in Pixelorama.
The last row of movement is visually cut off and is deliberately unused. Northeast movement is a horizontal reflection of northwest.
Frontal walking has one clean supplied pose; it is not represented as a fully authored front walk.
Many source frames already include a khopesh. Do not overlay an extra procedural sword on those frames.
Alpha is real, mostly near251; opaque red/green/yellow fringe pixels exist and need technical cleanup.
Per-frame scale is desired in-game scale. For Pixelorama canvas384x384 with export/game_scale .26, normalize each source image by frame.scale/.26.
Flip horizontally around the normalized foot pivot; pivot.x remains expressed in the unflipped source rectangle.
The curated metadata offers nearest-view aliases for unavailable orientations; these are explicit adaptations, not new original poses.
Principal connected body selections remove isolated neighboring fragments. Wide overlapping heavy-attack cells use tighter regions. These are extraction selections, not newly painted poses.
Slash effects use the same principal-component selection to remove adjacent arcs; isolated loose debris may be omitted.
